headline: Council of Europe bureau discusses draft privacy guidance for LLM systems and agents
summary: The Council of Europe’s Convention 108 Bureau reported that its 66th meeting in Paris on September 16–17, 2026 discussed draft guidelines on data protection in LLM-based systems, including agentic systems, with a view to finalization and adoption during 2026 and no later than the June 2027 plenary. The August 26 draft frames itself as interpretive guidance for existing Convention 108+ duties; it says it creates no new rights or obligations and does not prescribe specific technologies. The guidelines have not been shown as adopted in the inspected sources.
